summary: Default auth login uses tesla_auth (not dead void-callback), signing keys must be regular-file ECDSA P-256 PEM (RSA/P-384/P-521 rejected), fleet-register/command auto-detect bind to the hosted well-known public key only (no stale local PEM fallback), command fallback rejects sole key when Fleet credentials exist but PublicKeyDomain is missing, empty register key clears persisted PrivateKeyPath, compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token, error strings use clone+build (not @latest), docs lead with working flows.
reason: Tesla's OAuth rejects void-callback redirect_uri (404). fleet-register never persisted PrivateKeyPath and accepted directories/sockets/invalid/RSA/non-P-256 paths, causing silent failures later. Key resolvers picked arbitrary first-match by filename even when only one key existed, selecting an unrelated BLE/manual key when the sole candidate didn't match the registered public key. Command fallback accepted sole keys without verification when Fleet credentials existed but PublicKeyDomain was not configured. Error strings told users 'go install @latest' which fails due to upstream replace directives. Products --agent dumped huge cached_data protobuf. locateRelayPrivateKey hardcoded a personal car name. Docs taught the dead paste flow and used personal car names.
validated_outcome: Module build/vet/test pass (320+ cli tests). Default auth login uses tesla_auth or errors with install instructions. All key resolvers validate paths are regular files containing ECDSA P-256 PEM private keys (directories, sockets, unreadable files, RSA, P-384, P-521 rejected). fleet-register identity matching applies to every candidate including a sole key: local ~/.tesla/<domain>-public.pem wins, else the well-known HTTPS public key is fetched; mismatch or fetch failure errors and asks for --key-file. Command fallback rejects sole key when Fleet credentials (ClientID or AccessToken) exist but PublicKeyDomain is not configured. Tests cover: directory rejected, unreadable rejected, RSA rejected, P-384/P-521 rejected, sole mismatch rejected, sole match accepted, explicit --key-file bypass, fetch match/mismatch/failure, duplicate key files resolve. Error strings give clone+build instructions. compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token. Docs use generic <name>/<VIN> placeholders.
